evidence_items.explanation: Experiments ending by June 2024 found sales increases of 2.9% for search refinement and 2.1% for generated product descriptions; the presale chatbot increased sales 16.3% against unavailable live support. These are measured retail outcomes, although they do not establish net profitability or superiority to human support.

evidence_items.explanation: A randomized trial involving 9,691 patients at 16 Kenyan primary-care facilities found no significant reduction in treatment failure with LLM assistance. This shows that meaningful benefits are not universal, but it cannot erase demonstrated gains in a different industry.
